raw_response:
This small plot of mine, only 0.06 hectares, is planted with my perennial crop — mostly enset and some coffee, like many of us here in SNNP. I don't have money for chemical fertilizer this season, and honestly these plants do well with the manure from my cattle and the household compost I pile near the house. I will use the seedlings I already have from my own suckers, not buy anything improved. My wife and children and I will handle the weeding and mulching ourselves; there is no need to hire anyone for such a small plot, and rain is enough here so I do not irrigate.
